text: Every summer, Anna's whole family meets at her grandmother's house. Her grandmother and grandfather live in a small village, and all their relatives come to visit. Anna's parents, her mother and father, always bring a cake. Anna has one brother and one sister, so she is not an only child. Her older brother is married and brought his wife and their son and daughter. Her sister has a husband, and they have twin girls who look exactly the same! Anna's uncle and aunt also come, with her cousin, who is her best friend. Anna's grandmother raised eight children, so now the family is very big. Everyone in the family is close, and they get along very well, even when they don't see each other often. Anna loves her whole family. She thinks it is wonderful that so many relatives can still enjoy spending time together after all these years. This year, more than thirty people came to the summer party, and they stayed until midnight, talking, laughing, and eating good food.
